In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. One [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] citizen, a '''tough-looking woman''', fled into the swamps surrounding Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|Capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. While in the wilderness, the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] fell under the [[Mind trick/Legends|hypnotic]] influence of [[Savor Kibbs]], a charismatic [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] [[Force Adept]] that had been rejected for [[Padawan/Legends|training]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]]. Under Kibbs' influence, the tough-looking woman became an unreasoning fanatic who opposed the leadership of Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and promoted Kibbs' superiority.

Kibbs developed a plan to use the tough-looking woman, as well as other refugees that had fallen under his influence, to disrupt the peace treaty between the Naboo people and the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] so that he could seize control of the planet for himself. Elements of the plot were discovered by [[Lialla Tane]], a Human female agent of the [[Naboo Underground]]. The Underground, an organization that had successfully resisted the Trade Federation's occupation, dispatched several capable agents, mostly students from Theed's [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]] lead by Tane, to investigate Kibb's renegades. When the agents discovered Kibbs' encampment, the tough-looking woman and other renegades, a [[Unidentified Militiagung|Gungan warrior]] and an [[Unidentified angry young man|angry young man]], challenged the convictions of the Underground's agents.

Eventually, Savor Kibbs himself intervened, attacking the agents with [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] and a reprogrammed [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]], but was ultimately defeated. The dark hold he had over his followers vanished, and the refugees, including the tough-looking woman, were returned to the city of Theed and a normal state of mind.
